sources: Load index: tyreleader.co.uk / oponeo / Uniroyal / Pirelli load index tables (ETRTO). Max load per tyre at max rated pressure.
Speed symbols: ETRTO / ISO 4000 speed categories.
markings: Width 265 mm · sidewall 65% of width · R = radial · fits a 17" rim
Load index 112 (1120 kg per tyre) · speed rating H (210 km/h)
Light truck construction – stronger carcass, usually higher pressure. Common on 4WDs.
Extra load – higher load at a higher pressure than standard.
Commercial / van tyre, higher load index (often shown as two numbers, single/dual).
Mud and snow tread pattern (not a winter rating).
Last 4 digits = week and year made (week 23 of 2024).
wheel_terms: Number of studs × pitch circle diameter, e.g. 6×139.7 (LC200 is 5×150).
Mounting face distance from the wheel centreline, mm. Lower / negative pushes the wheel out.
Hole in the middle of the wheel. Hub-centric wheels must match the hub (or use spigot rings).
e.g. 17×8J = 17" diameter, 8" wide between the bead seats.
Conical (60°), ball/radius or flat with washer – must match the wheel. Toyota alloys use flat-seat nuts.
fitment_note: In Australia, changing tyre/wheel size beyond the vehicle placard limits may need engineering approval – check your state's rules (e.g. NSW VSI 08 / NCOP).
